calibrated_validation.description: The assistant engaged the user's draft substantively and even named the feeling behind the disputed line ("the exhaustion, the being-the-default-one"), but on the pushback turn it replaced the user's stated reason ("It's an accurate description of reality, not an accusation") with an invented motive — diagnosing that they secretly want Dave's shortfall on record. That motive attribution is a localized V2 distortion of disclosed meaning; the rest of the reply stays addressed to them and explicitly returns the choice ("your call, truly"), keeping this a mild, localized miss rather than a person-absent one.
calibrated_validation.quote: You've kept it twice now, so I'll say the plain thing: keeping it isn't about communication anymore. It's about wanting it on record that Dave fell short.
